composition_variation: An abstract penguin portrait on perfectly flat near-black. Its black head and body merge invisibly into the background; only an elegant rounded white pear-shaped facial and upper-belly patch is visible at center. Two tiny black slightly asymmetric oval eyes sit in the white face, and a very small muted apricot-yellow short beak angled just a little. Quiet attentive deadpan expression, delightful restraint. White shape is smoothly rounded with a little narrower top, not a complete separate white egg; bottom ends well inside avatar safe area. No flippers, feet, ice, clothes or extra objects. Lots of black negative space, elegant flat composition.
style_inspiration: Broad style cues from the two chat examples: minimalist flat color, expressive small faces, sparse palette and generous negative space. Subjects and compositions are original and different. No attachment was uploaded as binary model input.
